// This Pine Script® code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
//@version=6
indicator("Market Structure Precision Pro - CBLuxPro V1.5.1", "MS Precision CBLuxPro V1.5.1", overlay = true, max_labels_count = 500, max_lines_count = 500)

// --- Groups ---
g_ms      = "Market Structure Settings"
g_sig     = "Signal (Entry) Settings"
g_tp      = "Take Profit (Exit) Settings"
g_style   = "Visual Settings"
g_any_alert = "Any Alert () Function Call Settings"

// --- Inputs ---
pivotLen      = input.int(5, "Pivot Length", minval = 1, group = g_ms)
showStructure = input.bool(true, "Show Swing High/Low Labels", group = g_ms)
showBreaks    = input.bool(true, "Show Internal Market Structure Labels", group = g_ms)
filterByStruct = input.bool(true, "Filter Longs by LH / Shorts by HL", tooltip = "If a LH forms, Longs are disabled until a Bullish BOS. If a HL forms, Shorts are disabled until a Bearish BOS.", group = g_ms)

enableLong    = input.bool(true, "Enable Long Signals", group = g_sig)
enableShort   = input.bool(true, "Enable Short Signals", group = g_sig)
enableDiamond = input.bool(true, "Enable Diamond Signals", group = g_sig)
hedgeTrendFilter = input.bool(true, "Filter Hedge by Market Trend", group = g_sig)
signalDelay   = input.int(5, "Signal Delay (Bars)", minval = 1, group = g_sig)
sigFilterThresh = input.float(0.15, "Signal Proximity Filter (%)", minval = 0.0, step = 0.01, tooltip = "Avoids Longs if high is near a previous Peak (LH) or Shorts if low is near a previous Bottom (HL).", group = g_sig) / 100.0

// --- Take Profit & Exit Settings ---
useStructTP       = input.bool(true, "Use Structure TP (Signal Based)", group = g_tp)
tpDelay           = input.int(5, "Struct TP: Min Bars After Entry", minval = 1, group = g_tp)
tpSpacing         = input.int(5, "Struct TP: Min Bars Between TPs", minval = 0, group = g_tp)
minTpDistIn       = input.float(0.3, "Struct TP: Min Dist from Entry (%)", minval = 0.0, step = 0.1, group = g_tp)
onlyProfit        = input.bool(true, "Struct TP: Exit ONLY at Profit", group = g_tp)
useBosTpClose     = input.bool(true, "TP at BOS Body Close", group = g_tp)
enableChochExit   = input.bool(true, "Enable CHOCH Trend Change Exit", group = g_tp)

// --- Any Alert Settings ---
alertBuyInput         = input.bool(true, "Buy Signal (Triangle)", group = g_any_alert)
alertSellInput        = input.bool(true, "Sell Signal (Triangle)", group = g_any_alert)
alertHedgeLongInput   = input.bool(true, "Hedge Long (Diamond)", group = g_any_alert)
alertHedgeShortInput  = input.bool(true, "Hedge Short (Diamond)", group = g_any_alert)
alertLongXInput       = input.bool(true, "Long Warning/Exit (X)", group = g_any_alert)
alertShortXInput      = input.bool(true, "Short Warning/Exit (X)", group = g_any_alert)
alertOppCloseLongInput = input.bool(true, "Opposite Signal Exit (Long)", group = g_any_alert)
alertOppLongProfit    = input.bool(false, " - Only at Profit (Long Exit)", group = g_any_alert)
alertOppCloseShortInput = input.bool(true, "Opposite Signal Exit (Short)", group = g_any_alert)
alertOppShortProfit   = input.bool(false, " - Only at Profit (Short Exit)", group = g_any_alert)
alertChochLongInput   = input.bool(true, "CHOCH Long Exit", group = g_any_alert)
alertChochShortInput  = input.bool(true, "CHOCH Short Exit", group = g_any_alert)

colorTrend        = input.bool(true, "Color Candles by Trend", group = g_style)
bullColor         = input.color(#089981, "Bullish Color", group = g_style)
bearColor         = input.color(#f23645, "Bearish Color", group = g_style)
textColor         = input.color(#ffffff, "Text Color", group = g_style)
setupColor        = input.color(color.new(#5b9cf6, 80), "Setup Zone Color", group = g_style)

// --- Internal State ---
var float phy = na
var float ply = na
var float currentPH = na, var float currentPL = na
var int lastPH_idx = na, var int lastPL_idx = na
var int marketTrend = 0 
var bool longSuppressed = false
var bool shortSuppressed = false
var bool phFoundSincePL = true
var bool plFoundSincePH = true
var label lastBarLabel = na
var int lastBarLabelIdx = -1
var int[] allPivotIndices = array.new_int()
var float diamondLongLevel = na
var float diamondShortLevel = na
var float lastSH_ZoneH = na, var float lastSH_ZoneL = na
var float lastSL_ZoneH = na, var float lastSL_ZoneL = na
var int lastSH_ZoneBar = 0, var int lastSL_ZoneBar = 0
var box[] setupBoxes = array.new_box()

type PositionState
    bool bosDone = false
    int lastMainEntryBar = 0
    int lastFillBar = 0
    int lastTpBar = 0
    int validCandles = 0
    float posSize = 0.0
    float avgPrice = 0.0

var ps = PositionState.new()

// --- Market Structure Core ---
ph = ta.pivothigh(high, pivotLen, pivotLen)
pl = ta.pivotlow(low, pivotLen, pivotLen)

bool isLHConfirmed = false
bool isHHConfirmed = false
bool isHLConfirmed = false
bool isLLConfirmed = false

if not na(ph) and plFoundSincePH
    lastPH_idx := bar_index[pivotLen]
    array.push(allPivotIndices, lastPH_idx)
    currentPH  := ph
    bool isLH = not na(phy) and ph < phy
    bool isHH = na(phy) or ph >= phy
    if isLH
        longSuppressed := true
        isLHConfirmed := true
    if isHH
        isHHConfirmed := true
    
    if showStructure
        if lastBarLabelIdx == lastPH_idx
            label.delete(lastBarLabel)
        lastBarLabel := label.new(lastPH_idx, ph, isLH ? "LH" : "HH", color = #00000000, textcolor = bearColor, style = label.style_label_down, size = size.small)
        lastBarLabelIdx := lastPH_idx

    idx = pivotLen - 1
    lastSH_ZoneH := high[idx]
    lastSH_ZoneL := low[idx]
    lastSH_ZoneBar := bar_index
    bx = box.new(bar_index[idx], lastSH_ZoneH, bar_index[idx], lastSH_ZoneL, 
             border_color = color.new(setupColor, 0), border_width = 1, bgcolor = setupColor, extend = extend.none)
    array.push(setupBoxes, bx)
    diamondShortLevel := math.max(open[idx], close[idx])
    phy := ph
    phFoundSincePL := true
    plFoundSincePH := false

if not na(pl) and phFoundSincePL
    lastPL_idx := bar_index[pivotLen]
    array.push(allPivotIndices, lastPL_idx)
    currentPL  := pl
    bool isHL = not na(ply) and pl > ply
    bool isLL = na(ply) or pl <= ply
    if isHL
        shortSuppressed := true
        isHLConfirmed := true
    if isLL
        isLLConfirmed := true
    
    if showStructure
        if lastBarLabelIdx == lastPL_idx
            label.delete(lastBarLabel)
        lastBarLabel := label.new(lastPL_idx, pl, isHL ? "HL" : "LL", color = #00000000, textcolor = bullColor, style = label.style_label_up, size = size.small)
        lastBarLabelIdx := lastPL_idx

    idx = pivotLen - 1
    lastSL_ZoneH := high[idx]
    lastSL_ZoneL := low[idx]
    lastSL_ZoneBar := bar_index
    bx = box.new(bar_index[idx], lastSL_ZoneH, bar_index[idx], lastSL_ZoneL, 
             border_color = color.new(setupColor, 0), border_width = 1, bgcolor = setupColor, extend = extend.none)
    array.push(setupBoxes, bx)
    diamondLongLevel := math.max(open[idx], close[idx])
    ply := pl
    plFoundSincePH := true
    phFoundSincePL := false

if array.size(allPivotIndices) > 100
    array.remove(allPivotIndices, 0)
if array.size(setupBoxes) > 50
    array.remove(setupBoxes, 0)

// --- Breaks ---
bool bullBreak = false, bool bearBreak = false
if not na(currentPH) and close > currentPH
    if not plFoundSincePH and not na(lastPH_idx)
        int searchLen = bar_index - lastPH_idx
        if searchLen > pivotLen
            float lowestVal = low[1], int lowestIdx = bar_index - 1
            for i = 1 to searchLen - 1
                if low[i] < lowestVal
                    lowestVal := low[i], lowestIdx := bar_index - i
            if lowestIdx < (bar_index - 1) and (bar_index - lowestIdx) >= pivotLen
                lastPL_idx := lowestIdx, float prevPly = ply, ply := lowestVal, currentPL := lowestVal, plFoundSincePH := true, phFoundSincePL := false
                array.push(allPivotIndices, lastPL_idx)
                isHLConfirmed := not na(prevPly) and ply > prevPly
                isLLConfirmed := na(prevPly) or ply <= prevPly
                if isHLConfirmed
                    shortSuppressed := true
                if showStructure
                    if lastBarLabelIdx == lastPL_idx
                        label.delete(lastBarLabel)
                    lastBarLabel := label.new(lastPL_idx, ply, isHLConfirmed ? "HL" : "LL", color = #00000000, textcolor = bullColor, style = label.style_label_up, size = size.small)
                    lastBarLabelIdx := lastPL_idx
    bullBreak := true, marketTrend := 1, longSuppressed := false, ps.bosDone := false
    midX = math.round((lastPH_idx + bar_index) / 2)
    if showBreaks
        line.new(lastPH_idx, currentPH, bar_index, currentPH, color = bullColor, style = line.style_dashed)
        label.new(midX, currentPH, marketTrend[1] == -1 ? "CHoCH" : "BOS", color = #00000000, textcolor = bullColor, style = label.style_label_down, size = size.tiny)
    currentPH := na 

if not na(currentPL) and close < currentPL
    if not phFoundSincePL and not na(lastPL_idx)
        int searchLen = bar_index - lastPL_idx
        if searchLen > pivotLen
            float highestVal = high[1], int highestIdx = bar_index - 1
            for i = 1 to searchLen - 1
                if high[i] > highestVal
                    highestVal := high[i], highestIdx := bar_index - i
            if highestIdx < (bar_index - 1) and (bar_index - highestIdx) >= pivotLen
                lastPH_idx := highestIdx, float prevPhy = phy, phy := highestVal, currentPH := highestVal, phFoundSincePL := true, plFoundSincePH := false
                array.push(allPivotIndices, lastPH_idx)
                isLHConfirmed := not na(prevPhy) and phy < prevPhy
                isHHConfirmed := na(prevPhy) or phy >= prevPhy
                if isLHConfirmed
                    longSuppressed := true
                if showStructure
                    if lastBarLabelIdx == lastPH_idx
                        label.delete(lastBarLabel)
                    lastBarLabel := label.new(lastPH_idx, phy, isLHConfirmed ? "LH" : "HH", color = #00000000, textcolor = bearColor, style = label.style_label_down, size = size.small)
                    lastBarLabelIdx := lastPH_idx
    bearBreak := true, marketTrend := -1, shortSuppressed := false, ps.bosDone := false
    midX = math.round((lastPL_idx + bar_index) / 2)
    if showBreaks
        line.new(lastPL_idx, currentPL, bar_index, currentPL, color = bearColor, style = line.style_dashed)
        label.new(midX, currentPL, marketTrend[1] == 1 ? "CHoCH" : "BOS", color = #00000000, textcolor = bearColor, style = label.style_label_up, size = size.tiny)
    currentPL := na

// --- Signal Core ---
var bool waitingForHH = false, var bool waitingForLL = false
var bool hhReady = false, var bool llReady = false
if bullBreak
    waitingForHH := true, hhReady := false, waitingForLL := false, llReady := false
if bearBreak
    waitingForLL := true, llReady := false, waitingForHH := false, hhReady := false
if isHHConfirmed and waitingForHH
    hhReady := true, waitingForHH := false
if isLLConfirmed and waitingForLL
    llReady := true, waitingForLL := false
buySignalTrigger = hhReady and (close > open)
sellSignalTrigger = llReady and (close < open)
if buySignalTrigger
    hhReady := false
if sellSignalTrigger
    llReady := false

isNearHighRes = not na(phy) and high < phy and (phy - high) / phy <= sigFilterThresh
isNearLowSup  = not na(ply) and low > ply and (low - ply) / ply <= sigFilterThresh
isBodyTooLarge = math.abs(close - open) / open > 0.006
canSignalNow = (bar_index - ps.lastMainEntryBar) >= signalDelay or (ps.posSize == 0)

if bar_index - lastSH_ZoneBar > 15
    lastSH_ZoneH := na, lastSH_ZoneL := na
if bar_index - lastSL_ZoneBar > 15
    lastSL_ZoneH := na, lastSL_ZoneL := na

barcolor(colorTrend ? (marketTrend == 1 ? bullColor : marketTrend == -1 ? bearColor : na) : na)

isBlockedBySH = not na(lastSH_ZoneH) and high >= lastSH_ZoneL and low <= lastSH_ZoneH
isBlockedBySL = not na(lastSL_ZoneH) and high >= lastSL_ZoneL and low <= lastSL_ZoneH
isPivotBar = not na(ph) or not na(pl)
isLongBlocked  = (isNearHighRes or isBlockedBySH) or (filterByStruct and longSuppressed)
isShortBlocked = (isNearLowSup or isBlockedBySL) or (filterByStruct and shortSuppressed)
isBreakBar = bullBreak or bearBreak
priceBreachLong = not na(ply) and low < ply
priceBreachShort = not na(phy) and high > phy

finalBuySignal  = enableLong and buySignalTrigger and (canSignalNow or ps.posSize <= 0) and not isBodyTooLarge and not isBreakBar and not priceBreachLong and not isLongBlocked
finalSellSignal = enableShort and sellSignalTrigger and (canSignalNow or ps.posSize >= 0) and not isBodyTooLarge and not isBreakBar and not priceBreachShort and not isShortBlocked

bool finalHedgeLong = enableDiamond and not na(diamondLongLevel) and low <= diamondLongLevel and (not hedgeTrendFilter or marketTrend == 1) and not finalBuySignal and not isBreakBar and not priceBreachLong and not isLongBlocked
bool finalHedgeShort = enableDiamond and not na(diamondShortLevel) and high >= diamondShortLevel and (not hedgeTrendFilter or marketTrend == -1) and not finalSellSignal and not isBreakBar and not priceBreachShort and not isShortBlocked

if finalHedgeLong
    diamondLongLevel := na
if finalHedgeShort
    diamondShortLevel := na
if finalBuySignal or finalSellSignal
    ps.lastMainEntryBar := bar_index
bool isAnyEntry = finalBuySignal or finalSellSignal or finalHedgeLong or finalHedgeShort

// --- Exits ---
bool isBullChoch = bullBreak and marketTrend[1] == -1
bool isBearChoch = bearBreak and marketTrend[1] == 1
bool chochExitLong  = enableChochExit and ps.posSize > 0 and isBearChoch
bool chochExitShort = enableChochExit and ps.posSize < 0 and isBullChoch

isProfit = ps.posSize > 0 ? close > ps.avgPrice : close < ps.avgPrice
oppCloseLongTrigger  = ps.posSize > 0 and sellSignalTrigger and not bearBreak
oppCloseShortTrigger = ps.posSize < 0 and buySignalTrigger and not bullBreak
oppCloseLongValid    = oppCloseLongTrigger and (not alertOppLongProfit or isProfit)
oppCloseShortValid   = oppCloseShortTrigger and (not alertOppShortProfit or isProfit)

longBlockedTrigger  = (ps.posSize == 0) and buySignalTrigger and isLongBlocked
shortBlockedTrigger = (ps.posSize == 0) and sellSignalTrigger and isShortBlocked
longProfitExitX     = ps.posSize > 0 and isProfit and isLHConfirmed
shortProfitExitX    = ps.posSize < 0 and isProfit and isHLConfirmed

showLongX  = not isAnyEntry and (longBlockedTrigger or longProfitExitX)
showShortX = not isAnyEntry and (shortBlockedTrigger or shortProfitExitX)
anyX       = showLongX or showShortX

chochExitLong_h  = not isAnyEntry and chochExitLong
chochExitShort_h = not isAnyEntry and chochExitShort
anyCHoCHExit     = chochExitLong_h or chochExitShort_h

var bool suppressionActive = false
if isAnyEntry or anyCHoCHExit
    suppressionActive := false
bool canShowExits = not suppressionActive
if (anyX or anyCHoCHExit) and canShowExits
    suppressionActive := true
showLongX_f      = showLongX and canShowExits
showShortX_f     = showShortX and canShowExits
chochExitLong_f  = chochExitLong_h 
chochExitShort_f = chochExitShort_h

bool structTpHit = false, bool bosCloseHit = false
if ps.posSize != 0 and bar_index > ps.lastFillBar and not isAnyEntry and not anyX and not anyCHoCHExit and canShowExits
    if useBosTpClose and not ps.bosDone and (not onlyProfit or isProfit)
        bool bullCross = not na(phy) and close > phy and close[1] <= phy
        bool bearCross = not na(ply) and close < ply and close[1] >= ply
        if (ps.posSize > 0 and bullCross) or (ps.posSize < 0 and bearCross)
            bosCloseHit := true, ps.bosDone := true
    if useStructTP
        ps.validCandles := ps.posSize > 0 ? (close > open ? ps.validCandles + 1 : ps.validCandles) : (ps.posSize < 0 ? (close < open ? ps.validCandles + 1 : ps.validCandles) : ps.validCandles)
        distFromLatest = ps.posSize > 0 ? (close - ps.avgPrice)/ps.avgPrice : (ps.avgPrice - close)/ps.avgPrice
        if bar_index >= ps.lastTpBar + tpSpacing and distFromLatest >= (minTpDistIn/100) and ps.validCandles >= 5
            if (not onlyProfit or isProfit) and bar_index >= ps.lastFillBar + tpDelay
                if not bosCloseHit and not isPivotBar
                    structTpHit := true, ps.lastTpBar := bar_index

// Execution
if isAnyEntry
    ps.avgPrice := close, ps.lastFillBar := bar_index, ps.bosDone := false, ps.validCandles := 0
    ps.posSize := (finalBuySignal or finalHedgeLong) ? 1.0 : -1.0
else if oppCloseLongValid or oppCloseShortValid
    ps.posSize := 0
else if chochExitLong or chochExitShort
    ps.posSize := 0

// Visuals
plotshape(finalBuySignal, "LONG", shape.triangleup, location.belowbar, bullColor, size = size.small, text = "LONG")
plotshape(finalSellSignal, "SHORT", shape.triangledown, location.abovebar, bearColor, size = size.small, text = "SHORT")
plotshape(finalHedgeLong, "H-LONG", shape.diamond, location.belowbar, bullColor, size = size.small, text = "H-LONG")
plotshape(finalHedgeShort, "H-SHORT", shape.diamond, location.abovebar, bearColor, size = size.small, text = "H-SHORT")
plotshape(showLongX_f, "Exit/Avoid LONG X", shape.xcross, location.abovebar, bullColor, size = size.small)
plotshape(showShortX_f, "Exit/Avoid SHORT X", shape.xcross, location.belowbar, bearColor, size = size.small)
plotshape(chochExitLong_f,  "CHoCH Exit Long",  shape.labeldown, location.abovebar, bearColor, size = size.small, text = "Exit", textcolor = textColor)
plotshape(chochExitShort_f, "CHoCH Exit Short", shape.labelup,   location.belowbar, bullColor, size = size.small, text = "Exit", textcolor = textColor)
plotshape(structTpHit and ps.posSize > 0 and canShowExits, "Struct TP L", shape.circle, location.abovebar, #5b9cf6, size = size.tiny, text = "TP")
plotshape(structTpHit and ps.posSize < 0 and canShowExits, "Struct TP S", shape.circle, location.belowbar, #5b9cf6, size = size.tiny, text = "TP")
plotshape(bosCloseHit and ps.posSize > 0 and canShowExits, "BOS TP L", shape.diamond, location.abovebar, #2196f3, size = size.small, text = "BOS TP")
plotshape(bosCloseHit and ps.posSize < 0 and canShowExits, "BOS TP S", shape.diamond, location.belowbar, #2196f3, size = size.small, text = "BOS TP")

// --- Alerts ---
alertString = ""
if finalBuySignal and alertBuyInput
    alertString += "Buy Signal (Triangle) "
if finalSellSignal and alertSellInput
    alertString += "Sell Signal (Triangle) "
if finalHedgeLong and alertHedgeLongInput
    alertString += "Hedge Long (Diamond) "
if finalHedgeShort and alertHedgeShortInput
    alertString += "Hedge Short (Diamond) "
if showLongX_f and alertLongXInput
    alertString += "Long Warning/Exit (X) "
if showShortX_f and alertShortXInput
    alertString += "Short Warning/Exit (X) "
if oppCloseLongValid and alertOppCloseLongInput
    alertString += "Opposite Signal Exit (Long) "
if oppCloseShortValid and alertOppCloseShortInput
    alertString += "Opposite Signal Exit (Short) "
if chochExitLong_f and alertChochLongInput
    alertString += "CHOCH Long Exit "
if chochExitShort_f and alertChochShortInput
    alertString += "CHOCH Short Exit "

if alertString != "" and barstate.isconfirmed
    alert(syminfo.ticker + ": " + alertString, alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)

alertcondition(finalBuySignal, "Buy Signal (Triangle)", "Buy Signal (Triangle)")
alertcondition(finalSellSignal, "Sell Signal (Triangle)", "Sell Signal (Triangle)")
alertcondition(finalHedgeLong, "Hedge Long (Diamond)", "Hedge Long (Diamond)")
alertcondition(finalHedgeShort, "Hedge Short (Diamond)", "Hedge Short (Diamond)")
alertcondition(showLongX_f, "Long Warning/Exit (X)", "Long Warning/Exit (X)")
alertcondition(showShortX_f, "Short Warning/Exit (X)", "Short Warning/Exit (X)")
alertcondition(oppCloseLongValid, "Opposite Signal Exit (Long)", "Opposite Signal Exit (Long)")
alertcondition(oppCloseShortValid, "Opposite Signal Exit (Short)", "Opposite Signal Exit (Short)")
alertcondition(chochExitLong_f, "CHOCH Long Exit", "CHOCH Long Exit")
alertcondition(chochExitShort_f, "CHOCH Short Exit", "CHOCH Short Exit")
